name: Box Governance
description: Box Governance is an enterprise content-lifecycle and compliance add-on for Box. Organizations use it to define retention schedules, preserve content with legal holds, manage disposition, and support defensible discovery over governed Box content.
agentUseSummary: Box Governance is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Relay will not extend the existing Box content connection or expose retention, legal-hold, disposition, trash, export, or enterprise-administration actions until the exact enterprise has licensed Governance, Box has enabled the requested enterprise scopes, and the enterprise's Box administrator plus legal/compliance owners approve a bounded authority contract.

capabilities.label: Coordinate governed content lifecycle
capabilities.description: Preview a future exact-enterprise-authorized integration for bounded retention and legal-hold oversight without assuming access to governed content, custodians, policies, assignments, exports, disposition, or administration.

blocked.label: Connect without an enterprise Governance contract
blocked.description: Relay will not reuse a Box content grant or request Governance authority until the exact paid enterprise, Box Support, Box administrator, and legal/compliance owners approve the app, scopes, governed data boundary, audit obligations, test tenant, and production acceptance process.

blocked.label: Access policies, assignments, or custodians
blocked.description: Retention policies, legal-hold policies, assignments, custodians, managed users, folders, files, file versions, metadata templates, enterprise records, and related identifiers remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate governance state or export content
blocked.description: Creating, updating, assigning, releasing, deleting, extending, disposing, restoring, purging, exporting, or otherwise changing governed content or policy state remains blocked.

blocked.label: Use admin scopes, raw APIs, or the existing Box connector
blocked.description: Support-enabled enterprise scopes, Admin or Co-Admin tokens, service accounts, impersonation, browser sessions, the existing Box content connection, arbitrary API endpoints, raw responses, pagination, polling, bulk operations, and enterprise administration cannot bypass this review boundary.

approvalProfiles.label: Enterprise governance review required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until the exact enterprise, Box Support, Box administrator, and legal/compliance owners authorize a least-privilege Governance integration and live acceptance boundary.

runtimeSupport.description: Box Governance remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable before exact-enterprise authorization, Box scope enablement, administrator/legal review, least-privilege design, and live acceptance.

Box Governance remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable before exact-enterprise authorization, Box scope enablement, administrator/legal review, least-privilege design, and live acceptance.

providerSetup.blocker: Box Governance is a paid enterprise add-on. Its retention and legal-hold APIs require support-enabled enterprise scopes and correctly privileged Admin or Co-Admin authority over legally sensitive preservation and disposition state; the existing Box root_readwrite connector does not supply or authorize that boundary.
providerSetup.nextAction: Obtain written approval from the exact Box enterprise's Box administrator and legal/compliance owners, confirm its Governance license and test tenant, ask Box Support to approve the minimum enterprise_content plus manage_data_retention and/or manage_legal_holds scopes, define read-only versus mutating V1 actions and redaction/audit rules, then complete provider review and live acceptance before implementing a separate Governance authority.

evidence.supports: Box describes Governance as content lifecycle management for retention schedules, defensible legal-hold preservation, disposition, advanced trash controls, and e-discovery integration.
Box documents retention policies as a Governance add-on for Business Plus or Enterprise accounts and requires Manage Retention Policies plus support-enabled Global Content Manager access.
Box documents manage_data_retention and manage_legal_holds as enterprise-content-dependent scopes available through support review, with the enterprise required to have purchased Box Governance.
Box documents enterprise application authorization and notes that OAuth applications may require explicit administrator enablement under enterprise settings.
Box documents legal-hold policies, assignments, and held content as distinct API resources that preserve folders, files, file versions, or custodians.

securityNotes: No Box enterprise, Governance license, OAuth grant, support-enabled scope, Admin or Co-Admin token, service account, custodian, policy, assignment, governed file, export, disposition record, trash record, or legal data was collected or tested.
The existing Box connector's root_readwrite content scope does not authorize Governance APIs and must never be silently broadened or reused for this source.

Relay will not use administrator credentials, service accounts, impersonation, browser sessions, cookies, raw API exploration, exports, or provider-console access as a substitute for exact-enterprise legal/compliance approval.

All retention, legal-hold, custodian, user, folder, file, file-version, metadata, export, disposition, trash, policy mutation, administration, raw API, pagination, bulk, and destructive operations remain unavailable.
